env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd w
logos build -o $WORK/bin/nilpos$GOEXE ./g/cmd
exec $WORK/bin/nilpos$GOEXE
stdout '^later: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:15$'
stdout '^now-n$'
stdout '^last: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:32$'
stdout '^first: logos: nil from Go value stored into non-nil \*a\.User at q\.go:42$'
stdout '^both-pq$'
cd ..
cd ..

-- w/go.work --
go 1.27

use (
	./l
	./g
)

-- w/l/go.mod --
module example.com/l

go 1.27

-- w/l/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func Join(first *User, sep int, second *User) string {
	return first.Name + second.Name
}

-- w/g/go.mod --
module example.com/g

go 1.27

-- w/g/q/q.go --
package q

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/l/a"
)

func Later() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = "later: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	x := a.G(
		nil,
	)
	_ = x
	return ""
}

func Now() string {
	return a.G(&a.User{Name: "n"})
}

func Last() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = "last: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	_ = a.Join(&a.User{Name: "p"}, 1, nil)
	return ""
}

func First() (msg string) {
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			msg = "first: " + fmt.Sprint(r)
		}
	}()
	_ = a.Join(nil, 1, &a.User{Name: "q"})
	return ""
}

func Both() string {
	return a.Join(&a.User{Name: "p"}, 1, &a.User{Name: "q"})
}

-- w/g/cmd/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/g/q"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(q.Later())
	fmt.Println("now-" + q.Now())
	fmt.Println(q.Last())
	fmt.Println(q.First())
	fmt.Println("both-" + q.Both())
}
